Bill.BriefDescription: Permitting vehicle access along the Milwaukee Road corridor for lessees, concessionaires, and agricultural users.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to permitting vehicle access along the MilwaukeeRoad corridor for lessees, concessionaires, and agricultural users; andamending RCW 79A.05.320.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 79A.05.320 and 2000 c 11 s 39 are each amended to readas follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The state parks and recreation commission shall do the followingwith respect to the portion of the Milwaukee Road corridor under itscontrol: (1) Manage the corridor as a recreational trail except when closedunder RCW 79A.05.325; (2) Close the corridor to hunting; (3) Close the corridor to all motorized vehicles except: (a)Emergency or law enforcement vehicles; (b) vehicles necessary foraccess to utility lines; ((and)) (c) vehicles necessary for maintenanceof the corridor, or construction of the trail; (d) vehicles used bylessees and concessionaires operating under valid state parksagreements; and (e) vehicles for agricultural users for temporaryaccess; p. 1 HB 1939 (4) Comply with legally enforceable conditions contained in thedeeds for the corridor; (5) Control weeds under the applicable provisions of chapters17.04, 17.06, and 17.10 RCW; and (6) Clean and maintain culverts.
